visualRisks.description: Water and road colors are similar (#007fff and #ffd700), which might cause confusion for players.
visualRisks.recommendation: Consider using more distinct colors to differentiate between water and roads.

navigationRisks.description: The route path includes a diagonal movement (e.g., from row 3, column 15 to row 4, column 27), which might be challenging for players due to the grid layout.
navigationRisks.recommendation: Simplify the route to avoid diagonal movements or provide clear visual cues for such movements.
